title: Ellaz turn battle file
description: A battle is a grid placed on a painted field, and who starts where. It carries the field too (`view` and `art`), because a turn battle's field is not the fight's arena: the fight's arena schema is a z-band with gravity, and a grid has neither, so one file per battle holds the picture and the placements together - a second battle is one more file. `view`, `grid` and every c/r are VIEW PIXELS and tiles; compile.ts turns the grid into FP once. `art` is the loose object: only a cell opens it. What the subset cannot write, data.test.ts asserts: every placement on the grid and off the blocked tiles, no two on one tile, every `unit` a file on disk.

grid.description: tile (c, r) has its bottom-centre at (x + c * tileW + tileW / 2, y + r * tileH), in view px; a unit stands there

blocked.description: tiles nobody may stand on or walk through

art.description: the field's picture, for the cells; the sim never opens it
